steps.label: Convex set
steps.sub: The segment between two points stays inside

eyebrow: Checking the Hessian of portfolio variance
code:
Sigma = M @ M.T + n * np.eye(n)
eigvals = np.linalg.eigvalsh(Sigma)
eigvals.min() >= 0
# True: Hessian is 2*Sigma, always PSD
# -> variance w @ Sigma @ w is convex
caption: A covariance matrix is PSD by construction, so variance is always convex.

steps.label: One basin
steps.sub: No worse local minima to get stuck in

eyebrow: Not everything is convex: Sharpe ratio
code:
sharpe = (mu @ w - rf) / np.sqrt(w @ Sigma @ w)
# a ratio of linear and sqrt(convex) terms
# -> not concave in w without reformulation
caption: Sharpe-ratio maximization needs a convex reformulation before solving.

subtitle: Turning convex portfolio problems into the standard forms solvers expect.
